# Keys you hand over - qa-scout

## Outputs

- `work/context-manifest.json` - the scout's own artifact, validated on write
  Keys the validator requires: `ticket`, `acceptance_criteria`, `implementation`.
- `work/impl-diff.txt` - written once from the MR or branch the person named

Required at your stop (stage S1): `work/context-manifest.json`, `work/context-bundle.json`.

## Witness

Your witness artifact (stages.json `witness`): `work/context-manifest.json`.

## Handoff form

Contract `s1-scout-to-tester` (fill `work/handoffs/<dispatch>.yaml`; `handoff_check.py` reads it):

- `header.window` (required) - TICKET
- `header.verdict` (required) - one of vocabulary.header_verdicts
- `implementation.source` (required) - one of vocabulary.implementation_sources - diff|current-code|ungrounded
- `implementation.reference` (optional) - the MR id, branch or commit the diff came from, or what current-code was read from
- `implementation.diff.files` (required) - how many files the diff touches
- `implementation.diff.hunks` (required) - how many hunks in total
- `implementation.diff.production_files` (required) - how many of those files are production code, not tests or fixtures
- `implementation.diff.bytes` (required) - size on disk
- `implementation.ac_code_conflict.present` (required) - true|false
- `implementation.ac_code_conflict.decision` (optional) - the person's words, verbatim, when one was taken - which side is the oracle
- `scope[].id` (required) - SRC-ID or tracker key
- `scope[].state` (required) - one of vocabulary.row_states
- `scope[].reason` (required) - a verdict of at most 80 characters - the explanation lives in the artifact
- `scope[].relation` (required) - task|subject|parent|normative|referenced|mention
- `scope[].relevance` (required) - relevant|not_relevant|unknown
- `scope[].revision` (required) - the revision or hash this story read
- `scope[].read` (required) - full|peek|none
- `scope[].attachments_inspected` (optional) - n of m, or a dash
- `scope[].material_collected` (optional) - paths, comma-separated, or a dash
- `person.review_recorded` (required) - true|false
- `person.words` (required) - the answer about the sources, verbatim
- `person.accepted_gaps[].id` (required) - SRC-ID
- `person.accepted_gaps[].words` (required) - the words for this gap, verbatim
- `person.late_sources[].id` (required) - SRC-ID found after the review; shown at gate A, never a second stop
- `artifacts.existing_coverage` (required) - the bundle's candidate list with exact selectors and assertion refs
- `claims.every_source_carries_a_decision` (required) - true|false
- `claims.every_unavailable_source_carries_the_recorded_words` (required) - true|false
- `claims.diff_is_complete_not_truncated` (required) - true|false
- `claims.implementation_source_recorded_in_pipeline` (required) - true|false
- `claims.existing_coverage_search_was_bounded_and_says_so` (required) - true|false
- `tried[].requirement` (required) - R-n, a source id or an area
- `tried[].technique` (required) - the technique by its name in your charter
- `tried[].observation` (required) - what you saw, in one line
- `tried[].evidence` (required) - the path (and anchor) where it shows
- `tried_note` (optional) - why the table is empty, or a dash when it has rows
- `unresolved[].id` (required) - SRC-ID or area
- `unresolved[].reason` (required) - one of vocabulary.unresolved_reasons
- `unresolved[].detail` (required) - what exactly is missing, and what would settle it
- `blocked.field` (only when blocked) - the field of this file the role cannot fill
- `blocked.problem` (only when blocked) - what the role tried and what refused it, verbatim
- `blocked.tried[]` (only when blocked) - command or step, and its answer
- `blocked.data[]` (only when blocked) - path of anything the conductor needs to see

Every handoff form shares one skeleton (`common_shape` of handoffs/index.yaml): `inputs`, `inputs_read`, `header`, `scope`, `artifacts`, `claims`, `unresolved`, `blocked`.
